question: As on 27 November 2020, India's foreign exchange reserves stood at around _______ billion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**$574**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The foreign exchange reserve is the foreign currency held by the Reserve Bank of India.
 
• India's foreign reserve includes **Foreign assets, Gold reserve, Special drawing rights, and Reserve with IMF**.
 
• It helps in **managing crises, and r****upee appreciation** and boosts the confidence of investors.
 
• As of August 2022, India's Foreign reserve is **$572.978 billion**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Important terms related to Forex Reserve**__
 
• **Special Drawing Rights** 
 
 
• It is **not a currency** but a potential claim on the freely usable currencies of IMF members. 
 
• It is an international reserve asset, created by the IMF in **1969**.
 
 
 
• **Foreign Currency Assets**
 
 
• They are the largest part of forex reserves.
 
• They are value-based currencies expressed in Dollars.
